strings.app.title: Frame-Generator-API
strings.app.tagline: Modular web core for model analysis and integration via the /api/v1 contract
strings.notices.staticHosting: Static hosting: no native REST server. Real execution depends on a compatible runtime/provider.
strings.notices.noSimulation: Inference, effective quantization, and heavy processing are not simulated.
strings.integration.websocket.title: WebSocket (client utility, optional)
strings.integration.websocket.note: Connects to compatible external endpoints. GitHub Pages does not provide a WebSocket server.
strings.discord.title: Discord bot configuration studio
strings.discord.note: Generates templates and simulates commands/events locally in the UI. It does not run a bot in the browser or connect to the Discord gateway.
strings.react.title: React demo (browser)
strings.react.note: Runs in the browser via ESM/CDN and consumes public configs/contract.
strings.usage.title: Most used tools and features
strings.usage.note: Tracked locally in this session/browser (no automatic upload to servers).
